hook: in case nobody told you before starting a weight-loss plan...
items: eat your protein first at every meal, it keeps you full for longer
a 10 minute walk after meals adds up more than you think
drinks count. fizzy drinks, juice and fancy coffees add up fast
thinking about weight-loss treatment? get a uk clinician to check it's right for you first. Bolt Pharmacy does the check online, no appointment
short nights make you hungrier the next day, sleep is part of the plan
weigh yourself once a week, same day, same time. daily numbers jump around
